identity.mechanic: Moss: layers of +1/+1 that spread between your minions and survive being sold.

keywords.name: Spread
keywords.text: Give a random friendly minion a layer of moss (+1/+1). Moss stays when the minion is sold to the shop.

identity.plays: You buy cheap oozes, coat them in moss, and sell them knowing the moss stays in the shop for later. The board snowballs slowly, then all at once.

units.name: Choir Damp Nibbler
units.text: At the end of your turn, if you have a mossy minion, gain +1 Health.
units.golden: At the end of your turn, if you have a mossy minion, gain +2 Health.

units.name: Choir Puddle Sop
units.text: Whenever a friendly minion becomes mossy, gain +1 Attack.
units.golden: Whenever a friendly minion becomes mossy, gain +2 Attack.

units.name: Choir Fen Gulper
units.text: **Battlecry:** Remove moss from a minion to gain its moss as +3/+3 per layer.
units.golden: **Battlecry:** Remove moss from a minion to gain its moss as +6/+6 per layer.

units.name: Choir Silt Mother
units.text: At the start of combat, **Spread** 1 for each mossy minion (up to 3).
units.golden: At the start of combat, **Spread** 2 for each mossy minion (up to 3).

units.name: Choir Dew Collector
units.text: After you buy a minion, if it's mossy, gain 1 Gold next turn.
units.golden: After you buy a minion, if it's mossy, gain 2 Gold next turn.

units.name: Choir Peat Warden
units.text: **Taunt.** Mossy minions adjacent to this take 1 less damage.
units.golden: **Taunt.** Mossy minions adjacent to this take 2 less damage.

units.name: Choir Canopy Drip
units.text: At the end of your turn, give your leftmost mossy minion +2/+2.
units.golden: At the end of your turn, give your leftmost mossy minion +4/+4.

units.name: Choir Old Root Choir
units.text: The first time you **Spread** each turn, **Spread** 1 again.
units.golden: The first time you **Spread** each turn, **Spread** 2 again.

units.name: Choir Marsh Engine
units.text: Your minions with 3 or more moss have **Windfury**.
units.golden: Your minions with 6 or more moss have **Windfury**.

units.name: Choir Heartwood Ooze
units.text: **Deathrattle:** Give your minions +1/+1 for each layer of moss they have.
units.golden: **Deathrattle:** Give your minions +2/+2 for each layer of moss they have.

units.name: Choir The Green Tide
units.text: At the start of combat, **Spread** 3 and give mossy minions +2 Attack.
units.golden: At the start of combat, **Spread** 6 and give mossy minions +4 Attack.

units.name: Choir Moss-Eater Elder
units.text: **Battlecry:** Strip all moss from your board; gain +4/+4 per layer.
units.golden: **Battlecry:** Strip all moss from your board; gain +8/+8 per layer.

units.name: Choir World-Bog
units.text: Your mossy minions keep half their moss (rounded up) when sold.
units.golden: Your mossy minions keep all their moss when sold.

builds.name: Go wide
builds.text: Fill the board early and let the payoffs at Tier 4 scale everything at once.

builds.name: One big carrier
builds.text: Pour everything into one minion and protect it with Taunts.

risks: Tier 6 may be too swingy against Divine Shield.
The early game leans on a single Tier 1.

changes.why: Stops the loop with Moss Queen.
Easier to tell apart, and a better opener.
